**Texere 0.4.12** · 11 November 2026

- **Reload after an update reloads all of Obsidian**, so the new version starts and the message goes away. Before, only Texere restarted and "Texere … is installed. It starts after a reload" stayed.

Note: if you update from an older version, its Reload button still restarts only Texere; quit and reopen Obsidian once, and from then on Reload works.

Also in this version (from 0.4.11): clearer first steps on the home page — a thin progress line, the next step with one line on how and a link that takes you there.

Update: the **Update** button on Texere's home page, or BRAT at startup.
